sufficient_coverage_criteria: Every existing domain has an explicit capability map, prerequisites, supported-build provenance, and links to adjacent workflows.
Every hard limit or native behavior has a current official source or a versioned reproducible measurement; recommendations and community practice are labeled.
All eight unresolved language leads have runtime/compiler dispositions or conservative wording that preserves uncertainty.
A packed, inspected, booted fixture demonstrates multi-PBO dependencies, client/server separation, build, signing, deployment, update, and rollback.
Consequential RPC, permission, persistence, CE, and transaction examples include risk-appropriate authorization, malformed input, replay, disconnect, restart, partial failure, and recovery checks.
Entity persistence migration and CE terrain/diagnostic workflows are taught and validated, not merely named.
Every tutorial states dependencies, placement, execution context, expected result, error path, and validation level; strong readiness claims have fresh proof.
Operator guidance covers credential separation, least privilege, network exposure, observability, clean shutdown, verified restore, rollback, and build/mod compatibility.
The supplied local corpus has a source-classified crosswalk to EN, and planned contracts or beta behavior are not represented as shipped behavior without independent evidence.
Current EN links/anchors and VitePress build pass after integration, and affected generated artifacts plus the graph are refreshed and reviewed.
Remaining unknowns and optional candidates remain visible; page count, build success, or worker completion is not treated as proof of perfect correctness.
limitations: No compiler, game, server, client, asset tool, PBO build, exploit, transaction, performance, backup/restore, Workshop, or CE diagnostic command was executed for this map.
Direct BIKI page bodies returned HTTP 403; search-indexed official text and pinned official repositories were used with that access limitation recorded.
Local extraction and non-wiki documents are snapshots; missing declarations cannot prove native absence.
Local beta and public mod code is fallible and was used as implementation evidence only.

Only source paths explicitly listed as opened in this artifact were reviewed for this bounded map; the wider 64-entry corpus is preserved in user-source-paths.txt and user-source-inventory.json but requires CORPUS-C01, because inventory status is not review status.
The separate PBO research and language runtime probes were still in flight and require reviewed integration before overall closeout; the anchor repair is integrated and independently reviewed.
This is a bounded sufficiency map, not a claim of universal completeness or author approval.
